name: Nutanix Cloud Platform
certifications: NCP Unified Storage, Cloud Native and Database tracks
tools: Flow Virtual Networking and Flow Network Security

beginner.summary: For virtualisation and infrastructure administrators who are starting with Nutanix. Covers hyperconverged infrastructure, a Community Edition lab, cluster architecture and the Distributed Storage Fabric, Prism Element and Prism Central, AHV virtual machines and networking, storage containers and data efficiency, images and guest tools, snapshots and protection policies, disaster recovery, Volumes, Files and Objects, Life Cycle Manager, access control, alerts and NCC health checks, capacity planning, migration from VMware with Nutanix Move, the CLI and APIs and troubleshooting. Covers the NCA 7.5 topics.
prerequisites: Has administered virtual machines on VMware, Hyper-V or another hypervisor
Understands IP networking, VLANs and storage basics
outcomes: Explain Nutanix architecture and manage clusters with Prism Element and Prism Central
Run AHV virtual machines, networks and storage containers
Protect, replicate and recover workloads and run file, block and object storage
Migrate VMs from VMware, upgrade with LCM, monitor and troubleshoot clusters

days.topic: Nutanix Overview: Hyperconverged Infrastructure and the Nutanix Cloud Platform
subtopics: What the Nutanix Cloud Platform includes
Nutanix Unified Storage, Kubernetes and database services
Nutanix on premises and in public clouds
Nutanix as an alternative to VMware
Course project overview: moving a VMware estate to Nutanix
days.lab_task: Explore a Nutanix environment in Test Drive or the lab, find a VM, a storage container and a protection policy, and map the course estate to Nutanix products.
days.deliverable: Product map for the course estate
checks: A VM, a container and a policy are located
Course workloads map to Nutanix products

days.topic: Lab Setup: Nutanix Community Edition, Prism Element and Prism Central
subtopics: Community Edition hardware and nested options
Cluster creation and the first login
Registering the cluster with Prism Central
days.lab_task: Install a Community Edition cluster, set DNS and NTP, deploy Prism Central, register the cluster and confirm both consoles are healthy.
days.deliverable: Ready Nutanix lab with Prism Central
checks: The cluster is up and healthy
The cluster appears in Prism Central

days.topic: Cluster Architecture: Nodes, Controller VMs and the Distributed Storage Fabric
subtopics: The Controller VM on every node
days.lab_task: Trace a VM write through the Controller VM and replication factor, power off a node in the lab and watch data rebuild and the VM restart.
days.deliverable: Architecture notes with a node failure test
checks: The write path is drawn correctly
The VM restarts after the node fails

days.topic: Prism Element and Prism Central: Management Planes and Dashboards
days.lab_task: Create categories for environments and teams, tag VMs, build a Prism Central dashboard and schedule a weekly report.
checks: VMs carry environment and team categories
The dashboard shows health and capacity
objectives: Use Prism Element and Prism Central

days.topic: AHV Virtual Machines: Creating, Cloning and Managing VMs
days.lab_task: Create Linux and Windows VMs, clone one, live migrate it between hosts and change its resources while it runs where supported.
checks: Both VMs run with the planned settings

days.topic: AHV Networking: Virtual Switches, VLANs and IP Address Management
days.lab_task: Create VLAN subnets with Nutanix IPAM, connect VMs, view the network path in network visualisation and change bond settings safely.
checks: VMs on each subnet get addresses and reach their gateway
The bond change causes no outage

days.topic: Storage Containers, Compression, Deduplication and Erasure Coding
days.lab_task: Create containers for VDI, databases and backups with suitable efficiency settings, load sample data and compare the savings.
checks: Each container has settings for its workload
Savings are measured for each container

days.topic: Images, Templates and Guest Tools
days.lab_task: Upload images, build Windows and Linux templates with guest tools and VirtIO drivers, and deploy VMs with Sysprep and cloud-init customisation.
checks: Images are available on the cluster
Deployed VMs get their names and settings

days.topic: Data Protection: Snapshots, Protection Policies and Recovery Points
days.lab_task: Protect VMs by category with a policy, take application-consistent recovery points, restore a VM and recover a single file.
checks: A VM is restored from a recovery point

days.topic: Disaster Recovery with Nutanix Disaster Recovery: Recovery Plans and Failover
days.lab_task: Replicate VMs to a second lab cluster, build a recovery plan with network mapping, run a test failover and a planned failover and fail back.
checks: Recovery points arrive at the second cluster
The test failover runs without affecting production
VMs return to the primary site

days.topic: Volumes and Files: Block and File Services with Nutanix Unified Storage
subtopics: Nutanix Volumes for iSCSI block storage
days.lab_task: Present a volume group to a database VM over iSCSI, deploy a file server with SMB and NFS shares, set quotas and restore a deleted file.
days.deliverable: Block and file services with tests
checks: The database VM uses the volume group
Users reach SMB and NFS shares
A user restores a deleted file

days.topic: Nutanix Objects: S3-Compatible Object Storage
days.lab_task: Deploy an object store, create a bucket with versioning and object lock, write data with an S3 client and use it as a backup target.
checks: The S3 client writes and reads objects

days.topic: Life Cycle Manager: Firmware and Software Upgrades
subtopics: Upgrade order across Prism Central and clusters
days.lab_task: Run an LCM inventory, plan upgrades with dependencies, run pre-upgrade checks and upgrade one component in a rolling fashion.
checks: Pre-upgrade checks pass or issues are fixed

days.topic: Users, Roles and Authentication in Prism Central
days.lab_task: Connect Active Directory, create a custom role for VM operators, scope it with a project and review audit entries for their actions.
checks: Operators manage only their project's VMs
Operator actions appear in the audit trail

days.topic: Monitoring: Alerts, Health Checks and Nutanix Cluster Check
days.lab_task: Run NCC, fix two findings, configure email and syslog alerts and tune one noisy alert.
checks: NCC findings are reviewed and two are fixed

days.topic: Capacity Planning with Intelligent Operations
days.lab_task: Read the capacity runway, model a scenario for fifty new VMs, rightsize over-provisioned VMs and recommend a hardware purchase.
checks: Runway is reported for CPU, memory and storage
The scenario shows the effect of new VMs

days.topic: Migrating VMs from VMware with Nutanix Move
subtopics: Nutanix Move overview of features and sources
days.lab_task: Add vSphere as a source in Move, migrate two VMs with data seeding and scheduled cutover, and check them after migration.
checks: The migration plan covers both VMs
VMs cut over with short downtime

days.topic: Nutanix CLI and REST APIs: ncli, acli and Prism APIs
days.lab_task: List VMs and storage with ncli and acli, create a VM through the v4 API with a script and report cluster capacity by API.
checks: CLI commands return VMs and containers
Capacity is reported through the API

days.topic: Troubleshooting Common Nutanix Problems
days.lab_task: Diagnose four seeded problems, a slow VM, a VLAN mistake, a full container and a failed replication, fix them and record the steps.
checks: Logs or checks back each diagnosis

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Running a Branch Workload Cluster on Nutanix
days.lab_task: Run the branch workloads on a lab cluster with networks, containers, templates, protection policies, a recovery plan, file shares, two migrated VMs and monitoring.
days.deliverable: Working branch cluster with a demo
checks: Workloads run with the planned networks and storage
The recovery plan passes a test failover
Alerts and health checks are in place

intermediate.summary: For Nutanix administrators and engineers who run several clusters, aligned with NCP-MCI 7.5. Covers cluster design and sizing, AHV high availability and scheduling, Flow Virtual Networking, Flow Network Security, storage performance, multi-site replication with NearSync and synchronous options, Metro Availability, backup integration, Nutanix Files at scale, Self-Service blueprints, Terraform, Ansible and the v4 APIs, security hardening and encryption, Nutanix Kubernetes Platform, Nutanix Database Service, Nutanix Cloud Clusters, large VMware migrations, performance troubleshooting, upgrades at scale and exam preparation.
prerequisites: Runs AHV VMs, storage and protection on Nutanix
Understands networking, storage and disaster recovery concepts
Comfortable with scripting or infrastructure as code
outcomes: Design and size clusters with suitable failure tolerance
Run overlay networks, microsegmentation, multi-site replication and Metro Availability
Automate with Self-Service, Terraform and the v4 APIs
Run Kubernetes, databases and cloud clusters on Nutanix and prepare for NCP-MCI

days.topic: Cluster Design: Node Types, Sizing and Failure Tolerance
days.lab_task: Size clusters for the course estate with Sizer, choose failure tolerance and awareness settings and write the design document.
checks: Clusters meet CPU, memory and storage needs with headroom

days.topic: AHV High Availability, Affinity Rules and Acropolis Dynamic Scheduling
days.lab_task: Reserve memory for HA, keep two database VMs apart with anti-affinity, pin a licensed VM to its hosts and test host failure and maintenance mode.
checks: Anti-affinity keeps the database VMs apart
The licensed VM stays on its hosts
VMs restart after a host failure

days.topic: Flow Virtual Networking: VPCs, Overlay Subnets and Subnet Extension
days.lab_task: Create two VPCs with overlay subnets, connect one to an external network, extend a VLAN for a migration and apply a routing policy.
checks: The VPC reaches outside through NAT
VMs keep their addresses across the extension

days.topic: Flow Network Security: Microsegmentation and Security Policies
days.lab_task: Write an application policy for a three-tier app in monitor mode, review flows, enforce it and quarantine an infected VM.

days.topic: Storage Performance: Data Locality, Tiering and Workload Placement
days.lab_task: Measure latency for a database VM, show the effect of data locality after migration, apply a storage policy and handle a noisy neighbour.
checks: The noisy neighbour no longer hurts the database

days.topic: Multi-Site Replication: Asynchronous, NearSync and Synchronous Protection
days.lab_task: Protect three workload tiers with asynchronous, NearSync and synchronous replication, measure achieved RPO and bandwidth, and recommend methods.
checks: Achieved RPO and bandwidth are recorded

days.topic: Metro Availability and Witness
days.lab_task: Set up synchronous metro protection with a witness, fail one site and confirm automatic failover with zero data loss.

days.topic: Backup Integration: Third-Party Backup, APIs and Immutable Snapshots
days.lab_task: Back up VMs with a supported backup product to Nutanix Objects with object lock, make snapshots immutable and time a full VM restore.
checks: Backups land in the locked bucket

days.topic: Nutanix Files at Scale: Shares, Data Lens and Ransomware Protection
subtopics: Tiering file data to object storage
days.lab_task: Scale out a file server, replicate shares with Smart DR, use Data Lens to detect a simulated ransomware pattern and block the user.
checks: The file server handles more load after scale-out
Shares replicate to the second site
The simulated attack is detected and the user blocked

days.topic: Nutanix Self-Service: Blueprints, Runbooks and Marketplace
days.lab_task: Build a blueprint for a two-tier app, publish it to the marketplace with quotas and approval, and add a day-two scale-out action.
checks: Users deploy the app from the marketplace
The day-two action adds a node

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible and the v4 APIs
subtopics: Building VMs and networks as code
days.lab_task: Define a subnet, categories and VMs in Terraform, configure the VMs with Ansible and run both from a pipeline with a plan review.
checks: Terraform creates the subnet and VMs

days.topic: Security Hardening: STIGs, Encryption at Rest and Key Management
days.lab_task: Apply hardening settings, turn on software encryption with a key manager, replace the default certificate and forward security logs.

days.topic: Nutanix Kubernetes Platform: Clusters, Add-Ons and Fleet Management
subtopics: Storage with the Nutanix CSI driver
Kubernetes on other clouds from NKP
days.lab_task: Create a Kubernetes cluster with NKP, run a stateful app with Nutanix volumes, add a monitoring add-on and upgrade the cluster.
days.deliverable: Kubernetes cluster with a stateful app
checks: The stateful app keeps data on Nutanix volumes
The upgrade completes with the app running

days.topic: Nutanix Database Service: Provisioning, Cloning and Patching Databases
days.lab_task: Provision a PostgreSQL database, protect it with a time machine, clone it to a test copy at a point in time and patch it.
days.deliverable: Managed database with clone and patch records
checks: The database is created by the service
The test clone matches the chosen point in time
objectives: Run databases with Nutanix Database Service

days.topic: Nutanix Cloud Clusters on AWS and Azure
subtopics: Moving VMs to the cloud cluster
days.lab_task: Plan a cloud cluster for disaster recovery, connect it to the lab through Prism Central, replicate VMs and run a test failover to the cloud.
days.deliverable: Cloud disaster recovery design with a test
checks: The cloud cluster design fits the workloads
VMs replicate to the cloud cluster
The test failover runs in the cloud

days.topic: Large-Scale VMware Migration with Move DirectPath and Subnet Extension
subtopics: Subnet extension to keep IP addresses
days.lab_task: Plan three migration waves, migrate a multi-VM application with DirectPath while keeping its addresses through subnet extension and run the cutover runbook.
days.deliverable: Migration wave plan and migrated application
checks: The application moves with its addresses kept
The application passes its checks after cutover

days.topic: Performance Troubleshooting: Latency, Hot Spots and the Analysis Dashboard
days.lab_task: Diagnose a seeded slow application with the analysis dashboard, find the contended resource, fix it and show the improvement.

days.topic: Upgrades at Scale: AOS, AHV and Prism Central Lifecycle
days.lab_task: Plan upgrades for three clusters and Prism Central with the compatibility matrix, run them in order and report results.
checks: Versions and order follow the compatibility matrix

days.topic: NCP-MCI 7.5 Exam Preparation
days.lab_task: Take a timed NCP-MCI practice set, map every miss to a course day and repeat the weakest lab tasks.
checks: A timed practice set is completed
Each miss is mapped to a course day
The weakest lab tasks are repeated

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Multi-Site Nutanix Platform with DR and Self-Service
days.lab_task: Deliver a two-site platform with sized clusters, affinity rules, VPCs, microsegmentation, tiered replication, Metro for one app, immutable backups, self-service blueprints, a Kubernetes cluster and a managed database.
checks: Clusters and networks follow the design
DR and metro tests meet their targets
Self-service, Kubernetes and databases work for users

advanced.summary: For infrastructure architects and platform leads. Covers enterprise platform architecture, hybrid multicloud with Nutanix Cloud Clusters, VMware exit programmes, enterprise disaster recovery, ransomware resilience, network architecture, microsegmentation programmes, storage architecture for mixed workloads, VDI on AHV, AI workloads with GPUs and Nutanix Enterprise AI, Kubernetes and database platform strategy, automation at scale, compliance, capacity, cost and licensing, operations at scale, performance engineering, edge designs and troubleshooting at scale.
prerequisites: Runs Nutanix clusters across several sites in production
Holds NCP-MCI or has equivalent experience
Responsible for platform design, migration or operations
outcomes: Design enterprise and hybrid multicloud platforms on Nutanix
Lead VMware exits, disaster recovery and ransomware resilience programmes
Run VDI, AI, Kubernetes and database platforms on Nutanix
Govern cost, compliance, operations and performance at scale

days.topic: Nutanix Platform Architecture for Enterprises
subtopics: Integration with identity, backup and monitoring
days.lab_task: Design the Nutanix platform for a company with two data centres, twenty branches and a cloud presence, and defend it in a design review.
checks: Clusters, management and integrations are defined
The review accepts the design with actions

days.topic: Hybrid Multicloud Design with Nutanix Cloud Clusters and On-Premises Clusters
subtopics: Burst and disaster recovery to the cloud
Network design between sites and clouds
days.lab_task: Write placement rules for on-premises and cloud clusters, design disaster recovery and burst to the cloud and cost the design including egress.
days.deliverable: Hybrid design with placement rules and costs
checks: Each workload type has a placement rule
Burst and disaster recovery paths are designed
The design is costed with egress

days.topic: VMware Exit Programmes: Assessment, Licensing and Migration Waves
days.lab_task: Assess a seeded thousand-VM VMware estate, map features to Nutanix replacements, align waves with contract dates and plan a migration factory.
checks: VMs and feature dependencies are assessed
Waves fit contract and licensing dates
The migration factory has roles and throughput targets

days.topic: Enterprise Disaster Recovery Design and Testing
days.lab_task: Define recovery tiers for twenty applications, build tiered recovery plans, run a non-disruptive test of the top tier and report results.
days.deliverable: Tiered DR design and test report
checks: The top tier recovers within its objectives

days.topic: Ransomware Resilience on Nutanix: Immutable Snapshots, Data Lens and Isolated Recovery
days.lab_task: Run a ransomware exercise, detect the attack with Data Lens, recover priority applications into an isolated environment and record lessons.

days.topic: Network Architecture: Flow Virtual Networking at Scale and Physical Fabric Design
subtopics: Physical fabric designs for hyperconverged clusters
days.lab_task: Design the physical fabric and overlay networks for two data centres, connect VPCs across sites and test gateway failover.

days.topic: Zero Trust Microsegmentation Programmes with Flow Network Security
days.lab_task: Plan a microsegmentation programme for fifty applications, discover flows for five, enforce policies in phases and report coverage.
checks: Five applications are enforced without outages

days.topic: Storage Architecture for Mixed Workloads: Databases, VDI and Files
subtopics: Storage policies and quality of service
days.lab_task: Design storage for databases, VDI and files across clusters, apply policies and run performance tests that prove each workload meets its target.
checks: Each workload has its storage design

days.topic: VDI on Nutanix: Citrix and Omnissa Horizon on AHV
subtopics: Boot storm and login storm planning
days.lab_task: Size a desktop cluster, deploy a desktop pool on AHV, simulate a login storm and tune the cluster to meet login time targets.
days.deliverable: Desktop platform with login test results
checks: The cluster fits the desktop count
The desktop pool runs on AHV
Login times meet the target during the storm

days.topic: AI Workloads on Nutanix: GPUs, Nutanix Enterprise AI and GPT-in-a-Box
subtopics: GPUs on AHV: passthrough and vGPU
Security and governance for private AI
days.lab_task: Deploy a private model endpoint with Nutanix Enterprise AI on GPU nodes, connect an app to it, measure throughput and apply access controls.
checks: Only approved apps can call the endpoint

days.topic: Kubernetes Platform Strategy with Nutanix Kubernetes Platform
days.lab_task: Design a Kubernetes platform strategy on NKP for three teams with fleet management, storage, security and upgrades, and pilot it with one team.
checks: The strategy covers fleets, storage and security
One team deploys an app on the platform

days.topic: Database Platform Strategy with Nutanix Database Service
days.lab_task: Assess a seeded database estate, design standard offerings with protection tiers and self-service, and plan moving twenty databases.
checks: Databases are classified by engine and tier
The move plan covers twenty databases

days.topic: Automation and Self-Service at Enterprise Scale
days.lab_task: Design an enterprise automation model with a self-service catalogue, IaC standards and ITSM approvals, and measure time to provision before and after.
checks: Catalogue, standards and approvals are defined

days.topic: Compliance and Security Operations: Audit, Encryption Keys and Evidence
days.lab_task: Collect evidence for an infrastructure audit, review access, rotate encryption keys and remediate two seeded findings.

days.topic: Capacity, Cost and Licensing: Nutanix Licensing and Total Cost of Ownership
subtopics: Cost per VM and per application
Comparing with VMware and public cloud
days.lab_task: Build a total cost of ownership model for the Nutanix platform, compare it with VMware and cloud options and produce showback per team.
checks: Licences, hardware and operations are included

days.topic: Operations at Scale: Fleet Management, Upgrades and Monitoring
days.lab_task: Design operations for twenty clusters with upgrade programmes, alert routing to ITSM, runbooks and service levels, and report a seeded month of operations data.
checks: Upgrade, alert and runbook processes are defined

days.topic: Performance Engineering for Business-Critical Applications
days.lab_task: Benchmark a business-critical database on Nutanix, tune VM and storage settings, set a baseline and detect a seeded regression.
checks: The regression is detected against the baseline

days.topic: Edge and Remote Office Designs: Small Clusters and Central Management
days.lab_task: Design a two-node branch cluster with a witness, protect it to the core, plan upgrades for fifty branches and plan node replacement by remote hands.
checks: The branch cluster tolerates one failure
Branch data replicates to the core

days.topic: Troubleshooting at Scale: Cluster Instability, Network Partitions and Support Cases
days.lab_task: Diagnose seeded problems, an unstable service, a network partition and a Prism Central fault, fix them, open a support case and write a review.
checks: Each problem's cause is shown with evidence
The support case has the needed logs

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Nutanix Platform and VMware Exit Design
days.lab_task: Present an enterprise Nutanix platform and VMware exit design to a review board with the architecture, hybrid placement, exit programme, DR and ransomware plans, VDI, AI and Kubernetes platforms, cost model and operations model.
days.deliverable: Design with evidence and a board decision
checks: DR and resilience claims have test evidence
Exit, cost and operations plans have owners
